_note: Illustrative eligibility heuristics only. Real PM-JAY eligibility is based on SECC 2011 deprivation/occupational criteria, NOT a simple income cutoff -- a user can be below the income threshold and still not be SECC-listed. Always point users to the official portal/helpline for a definitive check.

heuristic_eligibility.note: Actual eligibility requires SECC 2011 database inclusion, not income alone.

schemes.name: State Health Assurance Scheme (varies by state)

heuristic_eligibility.note: Many states (e.g. Rajasthan Chiranjeevi Yojana, Tamil Nadu CMCHIS, Maharashtra MJPJAY) run their own top-up or standalone schemes with separate income/category criteria.
